title: Incidence
summary: Assign calendar-year person-period denominators and counts of recorded outcomes within observed periods. Zero-event periods remain. This supplies event-incidence components; it is not by itself a first-disease incidence rate. Choose an appropriate roster and event definition before aggregating, and account explicitly for overlapping episodes.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
